items.description: Audio guide to Milgram's agency theory, situational factors in obedience, and Adorno's Authoritarian Personality.

items.title: Social Influence — Obedience: Situational Explanations (AQA A-Level Psychology)
items.description: Podcast covering the agentic state, legitimacy of authority, and situational variables in Milgram's obedience research.

items.title: Milgram Obedience Study
items.description: Documentary-style account of Milgram's electric-shock procedure, findings, and the ethical controversy that followed.

items.title: A-Level Psychology: Social and Psychological Factors in Obedience
items.description: Explains the agentic state and legitimacy of authority as psychological explanations for why people obey — key exam content.

items.title: Milgram & Adorno — Explanations for Obedience
items.description: Pairs Milgram's situational account with Adorno's dispositional Authoritarian Personality theory, exactly as required by AQA.

items.title: Experimenter (2015)
items.description: Biopic of Stanley Milgram dramatising his obedience experiments at Yale — brings the ethical dilemmas vividly to life.

items.title: Die Welle / The Wave (2008)
items.description: German film showing how a teacher's classroom experiment in obedience and conformity spirals into a terrifying autocracy.

items.description: Bitesize revision hub for AQA GCSE Psychology — covers obedience, Milgram's research, and the Authoritarian Personality.
